decisions.reason: The product has shown clear positive market validation through repeated gold-award recognition, fits the firm's seasonal confectionery strengths, and is therefore an option whose value is already sufficiently proven to justify continuation.

As a bread innovation close to the core range that remained prominently listed for two years, it likely has acceptable demand and low continuation cost, so management would keep the option open despite less explicit performance evidence.

This marzipan stollen is a low-risk extension of the firm's established Christmas business and can share production, brand, and seasonal sales channels with adjacent products, making retention more attractive than withdrawal.
